title: Glossary of Industry Terms
oneLiner: About 1,000 terms from algorithms to PLCs and AI, each in a sentence or two of plain English, searchable and filterable by topic.
keyTakeaway: Most jargon names a simple idea. If you can say what a term means in one plain sentence and name a related term it is often confused with, you understand it well enough to use it in a meeting or an interview.
explanation:
Software and automation teams use a lot of shorthand: idempotent, p99, blue-green, SCADA, historian, bar raiser. Hearing one you don't know can make a whole conversation hard to follow, and most of them turn out to describe something simple.

Search by name or by words in the definition, or narrow the list to one topic. Each entry has a short definition, related terms you can jump to, and, where the academy has one, a link to the lesson that covers the idea in depth.

When you've read through a topic, use Flash Cards to make the terms stick and the Term Quiz to check yourself.
